user.title: Add a Landbook fan
user.description: Connects to the fan directly on your network (TCP 6607). Give the fan a fixed IP in your router first.

data_description.auth_key: The fan's authKey from the Landbook cloud (24 characters, ends in ==). It changes whenever the fan is re-paired.

reauth_confirm.title: Fan rejected its key
reauth_confirm.description: The fan was probably re-paired in Landbook, which gives it a new auth key. Enter the new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the fan on port 6607. Check the IP and that the fan is on.
error.invalid_auth: The fan rejected this auth key.
error.invalid_key: That doesn't look like a valid auth key (base64, 16 bytes).

abort.already_configured: This fan is already set up.
